key_points: DOJ closed antitrust investigation into NextEra's $66.8B acquisition of Dominion, removing a major federal hurdle
Virginia State Corporation Commission hearings ongoing - critical state-level approval still pending
Significant institutional buying: $111.8M ETF inflows on Nov 18, $123M on Nov 17, plus Capital Group added $720M across portfolio including D
Merger outcome remains uncertain; Virginia regulators focus on ratepayer impacts and reliability commitments
If approved, deal would be thesis-changing; if blocked, D remains standalone regulated utility with 5%+ yield
